signIn.title: Clinic team sign-in
signIn.subtitle: Enter the email and password registered for the clinic

email.label: Email
email.invalid: The email is not valid — like name@clinic.com

signIn.newAccount: New account? Open the link in the email to set a password.

banner.ended: The session has ended. Sign in again to continue.
banner.invalid: The email or password is incorrect.
banner.unreachable: The server could not be reached. Try again shortly.
banner.codeNotSent: The verification code could not be sent to the email. Try again shortly.
banner.lockedBefore: The account was locked after failed sign-in attempts. It opens after
banner.lockedAfter: , or at once when the password is reset from "Forgot the password?".
banner.disabled: This account cannot sign in: it is disabled. Whoever manages users in the clinic can re-enable it.
banner.suspended: The clinic is suspended, so no session can be opened and signing in is not possible now. Contacting the support team is the only way.
banner.blocked: Signing in from this network is blocked now. Contact the support team to learn why and have it lifted.
banner.rateLimitedBefore: Too many requests from this network. Try again in
banner.unexpected: The request could not be completed. Try again shortly.

code.title: Two-step verification
code.subtitle: Enter the 6-digit code sent to the email
code.label: Verification code
code.resend: No code yet? Send it again
code.noMoreResends: No more codes can be sent for this sign-in. Going back to sign-in starts again.

banner.invalid: The code is incorrect or has expired. A new code can be requested.
banner.resendFailed: A new code could not be sent. The earlier code stays valid until it expires.
banner.accepted: The code is correct; signed in.
